label: Essence
resolution: Scott's variant and Gödel's 1970 variant define 'essence' differently, and their statements and results keep the two apart. Scott's ess (DEF-ESSENCE-SCOTT) requires the bearer to have the essence, and its inclusion quantifies over all individuals; Gödel's 1970 Ess. (DEF-ESSENCE-GOEDEL-1970) drops that conjunct and quantifies over existing individuals. They are separate Lean declarations, `TruthCore.Isabelle.AFP.GoedelGod.Essence` and `TruthCore.Isabelle.AFP.NotesOnGoedel.GoedelVariantHOML1.Essence`, and no statement treats one as the other. The difference is what the paired results SCOTT-EMPTY-PROPERTY-NOT-ESSENCE and GOEDEL-1970-EMPTY-PROPERTY-IS-ESSENCE show, and it is what makes the 1970 axioms inconsistent (GOEDEL-1970-INCONSISTENT) while Scott's are satisfiable. Neither is the Thomist essence. Thomistic essence as nature/quiddity in the attribute readings is distinct from either modal essence definition; the claim of identity with esse is separate from this term’s definition. `FilteredEssence` (DEF-FILTERED-ESSENCE) is a stipulated experiment that filters comparison properties in Scott's structure; it neither changes the original Scott definition nor supplies an historical or metaphysical theory of essence. ESSENCE_5 (`TruthCore.Modal.ModalGrounding.EssentialTruth`, #1887) is the Finean essential-truth relation: it lies in the nature of x that a world-proposition holds. It is distinct from the q.3 a.4 represented essence (ESSENCE_3): the only passage between them is the explicit OPEN premise that whatever has its represented esse equal to its essence has its own existence in its nature, listed as a sense bridge where an argument uses both. ESSENCE_6 (`TruthCore.Causality.RootClosure.ProfileEssentialCondition`, #2145) is a Finean nature-relative notion of a different arity: it lies in the nature of y that x's profile of real determinations satisfies a condition, with a condition on sets of determinations as its content, not a world-proposition, and two place arguments where ESSENCE_5 has one; it is used where an essential exclusion must be stated for profiles that no world realizes. No passage between ESSENCE_5 and ESSENCE_6 is asserted.
